text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye achieved an unprecedented eight 
turf GⅠ victories.

That was a horizon no one in history had 
ever reached— She had finally broken 
through the 'wall.'

Naturally, that great feat whipped the 
public into a frenzy... and while dealing 
with all the matters flooding in, a few 
days passed in the blink of an eye—
choice_data_list:
(Huh...? I can't put any strength into my 
body—)

text_block_list.text:
By the time things settled down, perhaps 
from sheer relief... I felt like an empty 
shell.
(Tremble tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer, over here!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Here, write your name here. —It's a 
sign-up sheet for the yoga class!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's take on SUP yoga today! It's yoga on 
a board floating on water!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right, if your core isn't solid, you'll 
fall off the board, after all... It 
requires a great sense of balance too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Well, do your best!

"Even so, I take pride in having trained 
little by little while spending time with 
Almond Eye. I'm sure that the current me 
can do it—!!"
(Splaaash...!)

—Various memories flash through my mind, 
drifting past in a blur... Among them, the 
one shining most brilliantly is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye!! She has surpassed the 
"Emperor" Rudolf!! That's 8 turf G1 
victories……!!
(Waaah...!!)

“—Vivid sensations come flooding back... 
into an emptied heart. The roaring heat of 
the venue, the cheers... and Ai's innocent 
figure bursting with joy...”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer, wake up!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah! Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You don't remember? You struck a pose 
balancing on one foot and fell right into 
the pool with a huge splash!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...? Could you be... crying?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait a second...! I'm totally fine! It 
doesn't look like I hit anything either, 
so really, I'm okay—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...You don't need to worry about it, 
you know? Helping someone is only natural—
choice_data_list:
Thank you for showing me the view of 8 
turf G1 wins...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Right now?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Umm, I have no idea why it's happening 
right now, but... still—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there! That felt wonderful, 
didn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, you managed to stand on one 
leg properly too... It was truly time well 
spent!"
choice_data_list: So why'd you invite me today?
Why did you invite me today?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because it looks like you've lost your 
edge a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I would certainly hope you aren't 
satisfied with just this?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Once your mind is clear— let's head toward 
our next "desire to win"!
